article.title: Ter e haver existenciales: datos de Alagoas
article.part: Contraste Guatemala–Brasil y dominio avanzado C1–C2 — Contraste Guatemala–Brasil e domínio avançado C1–C2
article.chapter: Contraste español de Guatemala–portugués de Brasil — Contraste espanhol da Guatemala–português do Brasil

claims.summary: Vitório compares a spoken sample of 24 educated Alagoas informants with 10 UFAL academic dissertations/theses defended 2005–2010.
In Vitório’s samples, ter is more frequent in educated speech while haver predominates in the academic writing sample; results are limited to those samples.
Vitório counts 223 ter and 32 haver in 255 spoken cases, and 21 ter and 298 haver in 319 written cases.
Vitório gives Tem praias belíssimas em Alagoas and Há praias belíssimas em Alagoas as paired examples of existential ter/haver.
